examples.en: The town fought a losing battle against the sand.
examples.zh: 鎮上曾努力阻止沙粒覆蓋道路，但始終難以成功。

examples.en: The coach fights a losing battle every winter.
examples.zh: 教練每年冬天都在進行一場幾乎無望成功的抗爭。

meaning.en: To continue trying hard to achieve, stop, control or protect something even though success is impossible or very unlikely under the present conditions.
meaning.zh: 在現有情況下，成功機會極低甚至完全沒有，但仍然努力嘗試達成目標、阻止事情發生、控制問題或保護某事物。
naturalZh: 進行一場幾乎注定失敗的抗爭
明知勝算渺茫仍繼續努力
與難以克服的問題抗爭
勉強支撐，但幾乎沒有成功機會

register.summaryEn: everyday conversation; workplace discussion; news and general-interest writing; reports written in accessible language; personal reflection; descriptions of social or practical problems; stories and interviews.
register.summaryZh: 這個表達屬於中性至較口語的用語。
contextsEn: descriptions of social or practical problems
contextsZh: 使用平實語言撰寫的報告
register.formalEn: The expression is neutral to informal.
register.formalZh: 這個表達可能帶有令人洩氣的感覺，因為它暗示現有努力很可能不會成功。 直接向別人談及其個人問題時，可以在句子中加入可能的解決方法，使語氣較為體諒。

examples.en: We have been fighting a losing battle against the ants.
examples.zh: 我們一直與螞蟻問題徒勞抗爭。

examples.en: Before the roof was repaired, the family had been fighting a losing battle against mould.

examples.en: The town may fight a losing battle without more cleaners.

examples.en: The school may be fighting a losing battle.

examples.en: The team seems to be fighting a losing battle.
examples.zh: 團隊似乎正進行一場無望成功的抗爭。

examples.en: They continued to fight a losing battle over the old plan.
examples.zh: 他們繼續為舊計劃進行一場無望取得共識的爭論。

examples.en: They continued fighting a losing battle over the old plan.
examples.zh: 他們繼續為舊計劃進行一場無望取得共識的爭論。

examples.zh: 長期進行無望成功的抗爭，可能令人疲倦和沮喪。

examples.en: Fighting a losing battle against the problem was using all their time.
examples.zh: 與這個幾乎無法解決的問題抗爭，耗盡了他們所有時間。

examples.zh: 主辦者發現要在戶外舉行活動幾乎不可能成功，最後把活動移到室內。

examples.en: Fighting a losing battle to control the crowd, the organisers asked for help.
examples.zh: 主辦者難以控制人群，因此尋求協助。

specificForms.descriptionEn: Finishing the project increasingly looked like a losing battle.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 完成這個項目愈來愈像是一項幾乎無法成功的任務。

examples.en: Keeping the kitchen tidy is a losing battle.
examples.zh: 要保持廚房整潔，幾乎是一項無望成功的工作。

examples.en: It was a losing battle from the beginning.
examples.zh: 這從一開始便是一場幾乎注定失敗的抗爭。

examples.en: Keeping the café open had become a losing battle.
examples.zh: 要維持咖啡店營業，當時已變成一場幾乎無望成功的苦戰。

specificForms.formula: It + be + a losing battle + to + verb.

specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：It + be + a losing battle + to + verb。

examples.en: It is a losing battle to answer every message in one evening.
examples.zh: 要在一個晚上回覆每一則訊息，幾乎是一項不可能成功的任務。

examples.en: It was a losing battle to keep the room dry.
examples.zh: 要保持房間乾爽，當時幾乎不可能成功。

specificForms.formula: Is + subject + fighting a losing battle?
specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: Is + subject + fighting a losing battle?.

examples.en: Is the town fighting a losing battle against litter?
examples.zh: 鎮上是否正徒勞地處理垃圾問題？

examples.en: Could the owner be fighting a losing battle to save the old machine?
examples.zh: 店主是否正徒勞地嘗試挽救舊機器？

examples.en: Why fight a losing battle over such a small detail?
examples.zh: 為何要為這個小細節進行一場無望成功的爭論？

benefits.titleEn: It Combines Effort and Expected Failure
benefits.titleZh: 同時表達努力與預期失敗
benefits.en: the gardener is still trying; the gardener is unlikely to succeed.
benefits.zh: 園丁正與不斷重生的雜草徒勞抗爭。 這個慣用語同時表達兩項意思：

examples.en: The gardener is fighting a losing battle against the weeds.
examples.zh: 園丁正與不斷重生的雜草徒勞抗爭。

benefits.titleEn: It Evaluates the Present Method or Conditions
benefits.en: The sentence does not necessarily say that the goal can never be achieved. It says that success is unlikely under the present conditions.
benefits.zh: 如果沒有更多人手，團隊的努力將很難成功。 這個句子不一定表示目標永遠無法達成，而是表示在現有條件下成功機會極低。

examples.en: Without more staff, the team will be fighting a losing battle.
examples.zh: 如果沒有更多人手，團隊的努力將很難成功。

benefits.titleEn: It Can Introduce a Need for Change
benefits.en: The idiom can help a speaker explain why more support, a different method or a new decision is necessary.
benefits.zh: 只有一輛客貨車，我們幾乎無法應付。 我們需要另一輛車。 這個慣用語可以幫助說話者解釋為何需要更多支援、不同方法或新決定。

examples.en: We are fighting a losing battle with only one van. We need another vehicle.
examples.zh: 只有一輛客貨車，我們幾乎無法應付。我們需要另一輛車。

benefits.zh: 我努力保持廚房清潔，但感到自己的努力幾乎永遠不會奏效。

benefits.en: The same core expression can appear in several natural positions: What began as a simple job became a losing battle. Fighting a losing battle against the rain, the cleaner asked for help.
benefits.zh: 這個核心表達可以自然地出現在多個不同位置： 清潔工正在作無望成功的努力。 如果沒有更多協助，清潔工的努力將很難成功。 清潔工似乎正在作無望成功的努力。 要保持地面乾爽，幾乎是一項不可能成功的工作。 原本簡單的工作變成了一場幾乎無望成功的苦戰。 清潔工發現幾乎無法應付雨水，因此尋求協助。

examples.en: The cleaner is fighting a losing battle.
examples.zh: 清潔工正在作無望成功的努力。

examples.en: Without more help, the cleaner will be fighting a losing battle.
examples.zh: 如果沒有更多協助，清潔工的努力將很難成功。

examples.en: The cleaner seems to be fighting a losing battle.
examples.zh: 清潔工似乎正在作無望成功的努力。

examples.en: Keeping the floor dry is a losing battle.
examples.zh: 要保持地面乾爽，幾乎是一項不可能成功的工作。

benefits.titleEn: It Is Powerful but Not Automatically Better
benefits.titleZh: 表達有力，但並非任何時候都更好
benefits.en: The expression is useful when the speaker genuinely wishes to evaluate the chance of success.; more formal; more professional; more accurate; more suitable than a plain sentence. When the situation is only difficult, a plain expression may be safer: This will be difficult. We need more time. The present method is not working well.
benefits.zh: 當說話者確實需要評價成功機會時，這個表達十分有用。 它並不會自動令句子： 如果情況只屬一般困難，使用平實表達可能更合適： 這會很困難。 我們需要更多時間。 現有方法成效不佳。

origin.statusEn: Gradual Development; Exact First Figurative Use Unknown
origin.statusZh: 逐漸形成；確切首次比喻用法不明

history.en: The exact first figurative use has not been securely identified in the major learner dictionaries consulted for this worksheet. Those dictionaries explain the established modern meaning but do not connect it with one named person, event or text. The safest classification is therefore gradual metaphorical development rather than a single proven origin story.
history.zh: 本練習查閱的主要學習詞典沒有確實指出這個表達最早的比喻用法。 這些詞典清楚解釋了現代意思，但沒有把表達的起源連繫至某一位人物、事件或文本。 因此，最穩妥的分類是「逐漸形成的比喻」，而不是一個已獲證實的單一起源故事。

history.en: A literal losing battle is one in which one side continues fighting although it is not expected to win. Speakers gradually applied the same image to non-military situations:
history.zh: 字面上的 losing battle 是指一方仍在戰鬥，但已預計無法取勝。 後來，說話者逐漸把同一畫面應用於非軍事情境，例如：

origin.memoryEn: The fighting continues, but the likely result is already against you.
origin.memoryZh: 戰鬥仍在繼續，但預期結果已經對你不利。

rules.titleZh: 規則一：必須保留冠詞 a
rules.en: The expression normally uses the indefinite article a.
rules.zh: 這個表達通常使用不定冠詞 a。

rules.titleZh: 規則二：losing 必須保持 -ing 形式
rules.en: A lost battle usually describes a battle that has already ended in defeat. A losing battle describes an effort that is continuing or being considered but is expected to fail.
rules.zh: a lost battle 通常指一場已經結束並已經落敗的戰役。 則描述一項仍在進行或正在考慮中的努力，但預計不會成功。

rules.titleZh: 規則三：fight 可以變化，並非完全固定
rules.en: Do not force the base form fight into every sentence.
rules.zh: 不要在所有句子中強行使用原形 fight。

rules.titleZh: 規則四：fight 可以不出現
rules.en: Do not add fight when the sentence already has a complete linking-verb structure.
rules.zh: 要保持房間清潔，幾乎是一項無望成功的工作。 她知道這是一場幾乎不會成功的抗爭。 原本的一項小型維修，後來變成一場幾乎無望成功的苦戰。 如果句子已經使用完整的連繫動詞結構，便不應強行加入 fight。

examples.en: Keeping the room clean is a losing battle.
examples.zh: 要保持房間清潔，幾乎是一項無望成功的工作。

examples.en: She knew it was a losing battle.
examples.zh: 她知道這是一場幾乎不會成功的抗爭。

examples.en: What began as a small repair became a losing battle.
examples.zh: 原本的一項小型維修，後來變成一場幾乎無望成功的苦戰。

rules.titleEn: The Situation Must Be Much More Than Difficult
rules.titleZh: 規則五：情況必須遠比一般困難嚴重
rules.en: The task may be tiring, but the source does not show that failure is very likely.
rules.zh: 一名員工每天要接聽五百個來電，幾乎不可能全部處理。 這項工作可能令人疲倦，但原句沒有顯示失敗機會極高。

examples.en: The worker is fighting a losing battle to answer all the calls.
examples.zh: 一名員工每天要接聽五百個來電，幾乎不可能全部處理。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse It with “An Uphill Battle”
rules.titleZh: 規則六：不要與 an uphill battle 混淆
rules.en: A difficult struggle that may still succeed. A struggle that is impossible or very unlikely to succeed under the present conditions. Learning all the new software will be an uphill battle, but we have six months and a good teacher.
rules.zh: 一場十分困難但仍有可能成功的抗爭。 在現有情況下，幾乎不可能成功的抗爭。 學會所有新軟件會十分困難，但我們有六個月時間和一名好老師，因此仍可能成功。 在沒有電力和可用電腦的情況下，今天教授這套軟件幾乎不可能成功。

examples.en: Without electricity or working computers, teaching the software today would be a losing battle.
examples.zh: 在沒有電力和可用電腦的情況下，今天教授這套軟件幾乎不可能成功。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse It with “Lose a Battle”
rules.titleZh: 規則七：不要與 lose a battle 混淆
rules.en: The defeat has happened. The struggle is continuing or being considered, but failure is expected. They lost the battle yesterday.
rules.zh: 已經落敗。 抗爭仍在進行或正在考慮中，但預計不會成功。 他們昨天已經在戰役中落敗。 他們仍在努力挽救舊服務，但成功機會極低。

examples.en: They are fighting a losing battle to save the old service.
examples.zh: 他們仍在努力挽救舊服務，但成功機會極低。

rules.titleZh: 規則八：保留程度及確定性
rules.en: The incorrect answer changes a possibility into a definite judgement. They are having a slightly difficult time.
rules.zh: 錯誤答案把可能性改成確定判斷。 這個答案過弱，沒有保留原句中成功機會極低的意思。

rules.titleEn: Preserve the Goal or Problem When It Matters
rules.titleZh: 規則九：在有需要時保留目標或問題
rules.en: A reader does not know what the library is trying to achieve.
rules.zh: 讀者不知道圖書館正在嘗試達成甚麼目標。 圖書館正嘗試減少遲還書的情況，但恐怕難以成功。 鎮上曾努力阻止沙粒覆蓋道路，但始終難以成功。

examples.en: The library is fighting a losing battle to reduce late returns.
examples.zh: 圖書館正嘗試減少遲還書的情況，但恐怕難以成功。

examples.en: The town fought a losing battle against sand covering the road.
examples.zh: 鎮上曾努力阻止沙粒覆蓋道路，但始終難以成功。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Repeat the Idiom’s Meaning
rules.titleZh: 規則十：不要重複慣用語已表達的意思
rules.en: The second clause merely explains the idiom again.
rules.zh: 第二個分句只是在使用慣用語後，再次解釋同一意思。 園丁正與雜草進行一場幾乎無望成功的抗爭。 只剩下十分鐘，團隊要準時完成工作，幾乎已經沒有勝算。

examples.en: The gardener is fighting a losing battle against the weeds.
examples.zh: 園丁正與雜草進行一場幾乎無望成功的抗爭。

examples.en: With only ten minutes left, the team was fighting a losing battle to finish on time.
examples.zh: 只剩下十分鐘，團隊要準時完成工作，幾乎已經沒有勝算。

rules.titleZh: 規則十一：保留獨立的原因及條件
rules.en: The idiom replaces the judgement that success is unlikely. It does not replace the reason why.; the holes in the roof; the staff; the goal of keeping the room dry; the past tense.; they could not succeed.;
rules.zh: 這個慣用語取代的是「成功機會極低」這項判斷，並不會取代造成困難的原因。 由於屋頂有多個破洞，職員要保持房間乾爽，幾乎不可能成功。 保留： 濃縮： 他們無法成功。

examples.en: Because the roof had several holes, the staff were fighting a losing battle to keep the room dry.
examples.zh: 由於屋頂有多個破洞，職員要保持房間乾爽，幾乎不可能成功。

rules.titleEn: Use the Expression Naturally, Not Everywhere
rules.titleZh: 規則十二：自然使用，不要過度使用
rules.en: 1. somebody is making a continuing or repeated effort; 2. the problem keeps undoing that effort; 3. the available time, tools, money or help are clearly insufficient; 4. the other force is much stronger; 5. present conditions make success impossible or extremely unlikely.; somebody made one mistake; a task takes a long time; somebody lost one game; a plan is slightly inconvenient; the speaker feels nervous; success requires ordinary effort.
rules.zh: 這個慣用語最自然的使用情況包括： 不要只因以下情況便使用：

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond to each item using:
instructions.zh: 使用以下目標表達改寫句子或完成回應：

questions.prompt: The caretaker mops the entrance again and again, but people keep bringing in rainwater. He is very unlikely to keep the floor dry during the storm.
questions.promptZh: 看更不斷拖乾入口，但人們一直把雨水帶進來。在暴風雨期間，他幾乎不可能保持地面乾爽。
questions.answer: The caretaker is fighting a losing battle to keep the entrance dry during the storm.
questions.answerZh: 看更在暴風雨期間不斷嘗試保持入口乾爽，但幾乎注定無法成功。
questions.targetMeaning: To continue trying hard to achieve, stop, control or protect something even though success is impossible or very unlikely under the present conditions.

questions.prompt: The gardener removes weeds every week, but they grow back faster than he can clear them.
questions.promptZh: 園丁每星期清除雜草，但雜草重新長出的速度比他清理的速度更快。
questions.answer: The gardener is fighting a losing battle against the weeds.
questions.answerZh: 園丁正與不斷重生的雜草徒勞抗爭。
questions.targetMeaning: To continue trying hard to achieve, stop, control or protect something even though success is impossible or very unlikely under the present conditions.

questions.prompt: Three young children eat and play on the white sofa every day. Their parents are unlikely to keep it clean.

questions.answerZh: 到了會議結束時，公司要為自己的服務記錄辯護，幾乎已經沒有勝算。
questions.targetMeaning: To continue trying hard to achieve, stop, control or protect something even though success is impossible or very unlikely under the present conditions.

questions.prompt: A small pump was removing water from the basement, but heavy rain was sending water in much faster.
questions.promptZh: 一部小型水泵正在抽走地庫的水，但暴雨令水以更快速度湧入。
questions.answer: The small pump was fighting a losing battle against the rising water in the basement.
questions.answerZh: 面對地庫不斷上升的水位，小型水泵根本難以應付。
questions.targetMeaning: To continue trying hard to achieve, stop, control or protect something even though success is impossible or very unlikely under the present conditions.

questions.prompt: Nobody directly said that the project would fail. However, costs rose every month while the amount of money available remained the same.
questions.promptZh: 沒有人直接說項目會失敗。然而，成本每月上升，可用資金卻維持不變。
questions.answer: Finishing the project with the current amount of money increasingly looked like a losing battle.
questions.answerZh: 以現有資金完成項目，愈來愈像是一項幾乎無法成功的任務。
questions.targetMeaning: To continue trying hard to achieve, stop, control or protect something even though success is impossible or very unlikely under the present conditions.

questions.prompt: The parents take away one phone to stop their teenagers using the group chat, but the teenagers immediately use a computer or another phone.
questions.promptZh: 父母拿走一部電話，試圖阻止青少年使用群組聊天，但他們立即改用電腦或另一部電話。
questions.answer: The parents may be fighting a losing battle to keep their teenagers off the group chat by taking away only one phone.
questions.answerZh: 父母只拿走一部電話，可能正徒勞地嘗試阻止青少年使用群組聊天。
questions.targetMeaning: To continue trying hard to achieve, stop, control or protect something even though success is impossible or very unlikely under the present conditions.

questions.prompt: The charity has only one van, while the number of families asking for food has doubled every month. It has rarely delivered everything on time.
questions.promptZh: 慈善機構只有一輛客貨車，但要求食物支援的家庭數目每月倍增。它很少能準時送出所有物資。
questions.answer: The charity has been fighting a losing battle to deliver all the food on time with only one van.
questions.answerZh: 慈善機構只有一輛客貨車，一直難以準時送出所有食物。
questions.targetMeaning: To continue trying hard to achieve, stop, control or protect something even though success is impossible or very unlikely under the present conditions.

questions.prompt: The speaker kept adding more detail after the audience had stopped listening. Extra slides were very unlikely to win their attention back.
questions.promptZh: 聽眾已停止留心後，講者仍不斷加入更多細節。額外的簡報頁面極不可能重新吸引他們。
questions.answer: Trying to win the audience’s attention back with more slides was a losing battle.
questions.answerZh: 試圖以更多簡報頁面重新吸引聽眾，幾乎是一項無望成功的做法。
questions.targetMeaning: To continue trying hard to achieve, stop, control or protect something even though success is impossible or very unlikely under the present conditions.

questions.prompt: The seller continued refusing a refund, but the customer had signed messages and bank records proving that the item had never arrived.
questions.promptZh: 賣方繼續拒絕退款，但顧客持有已簽署的訊息和銀行記錄，證明貨品從未送達。
questions.answer: Once the customer showed the signed messages and bank records, the seller was fighting a losing battle to defend its refusal.
questions.answerZh: 顧客出示已簽署的訊息和銀行記錄後，賣方要為拒絕退款辯護，幾乎已經沒有勝算。
questions.targetMeaning: To continue trying hard to achieve, stop, control or protect something even though success is impossible or very unlikely under the present conditions.

questions.prompt: Thousands of people visit the beach each week, but the town provides very few bins and only two cleaners. The beach will not remain free of litter unless those conditions change.
questions.promptZh: 每星期有數千人到訪海灘，但鎮上只提供很少垃圾桶及兩名清潔工。除非情況改變，否則海灘不可能保持沒有垃圾。
questions.answer: Unless the town adds more bins and cleaners, it will keep fighting a losing battle to keep the beach free of litter.
questions.answerZh: 除非鎮上增加垃圾桶和清潔工，否則它將繼續徒勞地嘗試保持海灘沒有垃圾。
questions.targetMeaning: To continue trying hard to achieve, stop, control or protect something even though success is impossible or very unlikely under the present conditions.
